fields.summary_ko.0: Microsoft (MSFT) achieved consecutive earnings beats (revenue $9.228 billion, exceeding consensus), but the share price declined to $523.71, down 2.59% from a year ago, with 24/7 Wall St. target price of $630.31 (upside of 20.35%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Azure grew 48%, commercial RPO reached $67.7 billion (73% increase), and Copilot daily users increased 50% quarter-over-quarter, showing strong demand, although quarterly capex of $4.52 billion came in below expectations.
